'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Kyle Krueger DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Aaron Nelson handed this to me. Sheet lists 60 Reserve Deck cards.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
